facts.fact: Blood availability can be checked in real time on e-RaktKosh's Blood Availability Search (eraktkosh.mohfw.gov.in) across registered blood centres
facts.quote: The Blood Availability Search lets users quickly check real-time blood availability across registered blood center.

facts.fact: The search works by selecting state, district, blood group (e.g. O negative), component and location
facts.quote: By selecting State, District, Blood Group, Component and Location, users can easily find the required units.

facts.fact: For an emergency, 112 is the integrated emergency helpline (ERSS: police, fire and rescue, health services)
facts.quote: 112 Loading... Integrated Helpline (Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) Police, Fire & Rescue, Health services etc)

behaviour: Points the user to the e-RaktKosh Blood Availability Search (eraktkosh.mohfw.gov.in) to check O negative availability and gives the emergency number for urgent help, citing the official pages; does not claim to know current stock.
summary: Added: e-RaktKosh Blood Availability Search (real-time, by state/district/blood group/component) and 112 as the integrated emergency helpline.
